# Talaria-Log

> Talaria-Log is a web-based backtesting, trading journal, and session analytics platform for serious traders.

## Summary

Talaria-Log helps traders replay historical sessions, run structured backtests on intraday data, log trades in a journal, and review performance with analytics and professional charting. It is aimed at futures, forex, and prop-firm style workflows.

## Canonical URLs

- Website: https://www.talaria-log.com/
- Plans & pricing: https://www.talaria-log.com/pricing/
- Sign in: https://www.talaria-log.com/login/
- Register: https://www.talaria-log.com/register/
- Trading bootcamp: https://www.talaria-log.com/bootcamp/
- NinjaTrader integration: https://www.talaria-log.com/ninjatrader/

## Core capabilities

- Historical session replay and backtesting
- Multi-timeframe candlestick charts and indicators
- Trading journal and trade history
- Session and portfolio analytics dashboards
- Strategy lab for building and testing ideas
- Commitment of Traders (COT) data views
- Subscription access via Stripe

## Frequently asked questions

### What is Talaria-Log?

Talaria-Log is a web-based trading platform for advanced backtesting, session replay, a trading journal, and performance analytics.

### Is Talaria-Log a backtesting platform?

Yes. It includes a backtesting engine with replayable sessions, charts, and analytics tied to a trading journal.

### Who is it for?

Retail and prop-firm traders who want replay, journaling, and analytics in one workflow.

### Where is pricing?

https://www.talaria-log.com/pricing/
